name: concept-saturation-evidence
prompt: Gameplay concept art, 16:9. ONE single 1865 Victorian cobblestone street scene with gas lamps, a horse-drawn cart, brick row houses and pedestrians in 1860s dress. The frame is split by one clean diagonal line into two halves of THE SAME street: the left half fully desaturated grey monochrome like an unfinished wet-plate photograph, the right half rich saturated 1940s-50s Technicolor film-still color. A brass wax seal stamp hovers exactly at the diagonal divide, pressing color from the saturated half into the grey half. Strictly period-accurate 19th century setting: no modern buildings, no cars, no glass skyscrapers, no rainbow panels. Painterly photographic realism, subtle film grain
